title: DevDeploy
tagline: Deploy frontend & backend on-chain in minutes, costless, with seamless testing and iteration.
description:
We’ve developed a powerful developer tool that enables builders to fully deploy and run their projects on-chain in minutes—without relying on centralized infrastructure.

For frontend deployment, the tool uses Walrus Storage to publish static websites directly to the chain. Developers can deploy their GitHub frontend repositories as fully static sites in under a minute and automatically link them to a SuiNS domain, bringing their UI live on-chain without extra setup.

For backend deployment, we leverage Oasis ROFL (Rollup-Oriented Fully-onchain Logic), which allows developers to run even complex backend logic entirely on-chain, without any traditional cloud providers. Thanks to the low transaction fees of Oasis, backend functions execute affordably and reliably.

All of this is bundled into a unified interface where developers can:

Connect their GitHub account

Select frontend/backend repos

Deploy both ends on-chain seamlessly

Test and iterate without setup friction or hidden costs

This tool offers a costless, permissionless, and fully on-chain development workflow, drastically reducing time-to-deploy and making on-chain app development more accessible than ever.
how_its_made:
How the Project Was Built
In this project, we integrated Walrus-Sites and Oasis ROFL technologies to alleviate developers' burdens. By combining these two technologies, we simplified backend and frontend management, enabling projects to go live fully on-chain in just a few minutes.

Our Solutions
Significant Cost Reduction: By using Oasis ROFL and Walrus-Sites, we drastically lower costs. Decentralized infrastructure reduces server and storage expenses to an incredible level.

Minimal DevOps Knowledge Required: We’ve minimized the need for DevOps knowledge and configuration. Developers can easily deploy both frontend and backend just by connecting their GitHub repositories.

Fast Deployment and Management: Even with complex projects, we can deploy completely on-chain solutions in just 3-5 minutes using Walrus-Sites for frontend and Oasis ROFL for backend. Developers save time by skipping the typical deployment and configuration processes.

With these integrations, developers can focus on building their apps, without worrying about infrastructure management, speeding up their development process significantly.
